_note: All coordinates are in the 1920x1080 design space of the layer PNGs. Scale uniformly to the monitor (cover-fit, keep aspect, crop overflow).

layers.base: layers/L_base.png  (RGB) ground, gravel bed with raked pattern, stones, moss, tsukubai, azalea bush without flowers
layers.bed_mask: layers/L_bed.png  (L) 1 = raked gravel area; cursor ripples only draw here
layers.object_mask: layers/L_obj.png  (L) 1 = stones/objects inside the bed; ripples must not draw on these
layers.fern: layers/L_fern.png  (RGBA) bottom-right fern overlay, sways around pivot [1800,1080], amplitude ~0.7 deg
layers.canopy: layers/L_canopy.png  (RGBA) top maple canopy overlay, sways around pivot [960,-195], amplitude ~0.35 deg

rake._note: Procedural rake pattern used for cursor ripples (redraw sand with an offset phase where the cursor passed).
rake.shading: light from upper-left (-0.55,-0.83); sand colors dark #7E8573 to light #D8D9C6

time_of_day_grade._note: Multiply color, then optional screen tint (rgb, alpha). Interpolate between keys by local hour.

overcast_grade.note: cloudy without rain: no streaks, softer canopy shadow
